controls.label: Card height
controls.serializedMeaning: Sets the common nominal edition height; very wide sources reduce proportionally to fit the safe canvas-width bound.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed media/canvas/time, source heights and natural-ratio widths change while track order, baseline, identity lean sign, source treatment, and phase remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Edition scale determines how the collection reads and how many works fit.

controls.label: Gap
controls.serializedMeaning: Sets minimum source-to-source spacing; loop-safety slack may increase effective gap uniformly.
controls.causalObservation: Track length, source centres, and visible spacing change deterministically while source dimensions, order, baseline, treatment, and per-ID lean remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Physical spacing is intrinsic to collected editions and recycling safety.

controls.label: Lean amount
controls.serializedMeaning: Scales deterministic source-identity bottom-pivot lean; sign/order remain stable.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed source/time, baseLeanDeg magnitude changes proportionally while width, baseline, x position, source pixels, and stable hash sign remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Restrained placement variation is a defining Shelf physical cue.

controls.label: Direction
controls.serializedMeaning: Changes the sign of track traversal and exact finite playback direction without reordering Project media.
controls.causalObservation: At fixed story time, phase mirrors to the forward state at `1−t`; source order, geometry, baseline, and treatment remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: The prototype exposes Scene direction; production must map authoritative portable Timeline direction here without duplicate state.

controls.label: Spotlight lift
controls.serializedMeaning: Sets how far the serialized Spotlight/Finale edition rises above the shared baseline while straightening.
controls.causalObservation: During a focus hold, selected bottomY changes by the authored lift and lean becomes zero; neighbours, track phase, source scale, opacity, filter, and blend remain fixed.
controls.ownershipReason: Lift is the causal Shelf-specific expression of Spotlight hierarchy.

serializedIntentNotControls.reason: Walking speed and duration are story-time authority.
Final settled edition is semantic story intent.

rejectedControls.reason: Identity-derived lean prevents clutter and arbitrary placement.
